acceptance.aggregate: Per family/split/cost denominators, failures, mean/median/max regret, paired win/tie/loss; cost profiles are correlated, not independent samples.

runtime.report: median/range, environment and operation counts; no portable speed claim

adapter.canonicalize: sort by exact target ID before injection
adapter.decode: one action per half-open slot; gaps -> IDLE; reject overlaps and out-of-range block times
adapter.endpoint: all recommended false except explicit diagnostic endpoint_override
adapter.geometry: equal altitude 45 deg, azimuth 90 deg, airmass 1.4, Moon separation 90 deg; all synthetic placeholders
adapter.known_zero: eligible true and zero score remains recommended
adapter.null_score: map to zero only in unrecommended injected entry; preserve missing mask in record
adapter.site: latitude=0, longitude=0, elevation=0; no physical interpretation

controls.name: empty_target_set
controls.purpose: Idle is feasible with no targets.

controls.name: known_zero
controls.purpose: Known zero remains usable; canonical tie prefers target over idle.

controls.name: all_scores_missing
controls.purpose: Missing score is never rewarded or admitted.

controls.name: exact_ties
controls.purpose: Canonical optimum and immediate ties use ID order.

controls.name: retained_M55_switch_cost
controls.purpose: Reuse the published M55 example; not held out.

controls.name: same_target_after_idle
controls.purpose: A-idle-A does not charge a change.

controls.name: zero_cost_alternation
controls.purpose: Uncoupled per-slot objective and enumeration agree.

controls.name: optional_idle
controls.purpose: Candidate may idle even when a target is available; B0 remains policy-faithful.

controls.name: terminal_snapshot_excluded
controls.purpose: Endpoint planner snapshot never contributes a slot.

controls.name: utc_date_crossing
controls.purpose: UTC half-open slots cross midnight without changing the matrix.

controls.name: score_domain_edges
controls.purpose: Closed integer score bounds and zero ties.

input_schema.dimensions: slots is int 1..9, targets is int 0..3; bool excluded; matrices exactly slots x targets
input_schema.eligibility: literal bool or null; reject integer coercion
input_schema.provenance: source kind synthetic_project_definition, protocol ID/hash, generator commit/hash, input construction and transformation identifiers; no unqualified real observations
input_schema.score: literal int 0..100 or null, bool excluded
input_schema.switch_cost: literal nonnegative int, bool excluded; frozen campaign profiles are 0,5,20
input_schema.target_ids: unique ASCII target_[0-9]{2}; ordered columns correspond to IDs; canonical sort remaps both matrices; gaps in IDs allowed for removal controls
input_schema.time: canonical YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ with no leap-second input; slot_minutes exactly integer 60; UTC-aware parse
input_schema.transform_controls: may update IDs/dimensions/times consistently but may not silently alter scientific input values or split labels

invalid_input_classes.name: noncanonical_target_id
invalid_input_classes.rejection: Non-ASCII or unexpected ID; input order itself may be canonicalized

invalid_input_classes.name: noninteger_score
invalid_input_classes.rejection: Score=1.5, NaN or Infinity; all noninteger numbers rejected

invalid_input_classes.name: invalid_eligibility
invalid_input_classes.rejection: Eligibility=0, 1 or string instead of literal bool/null

invalid_input_classes.name: oversized_horizon
invalid_input_classes.rejection: N>9 in the v1 exhaustive input schema

invalid_input_classes.name: unknown_field
invalid_input_classes.rejection: Unrecognized input keys; no silent ignored constraint

methods.name: unchanged_production_greedy
methods.policy: max(score,altitude), stable input order; no recommendation means idle
methods.status: production exists; new adapter not implemented

methods.name: immediate_cost_aware_greedy
methods.policy: max immediate net reward over usable targets and idle, canonical action tie

methods.name: finite_horizon_dp
methods.policy: backward recurrence; exact integer values and canonical maximizing tie

methods.name: independent_exhaustive_oracle
methods.policy: Cartesian-product enumeration, direct feasibility and objective traversal; no DP or candidate helper imports

model.cost_units: nominal score points per target change
model.usable_rule: eligibility is true AND score is not null
model.visibility_model: supplied whole-slot eligibility, not sampled astronomy

next_mission.scope: Implement/freeze input and independent exhaustive oracle only; no B2 evaluation or production change.
next_mission.title: Controlled Schedule Corpus and Independent Oracle

preregistration.changes: New protocol version, reason, affected case IDs, outputs already inspected and approval before dependent work.
preregistration.freeze_rule: Merge Mission 63 before Mission 64 input/oracle work; freeze versioned input and independent reference releases before candidate evaluation.
preregistration.result_status: No optimizer or reference outcomes generated by Mission 63.

synthesis.encoding: ASCII field contents, UTF-8 bytes, unpadded decimal nonnegative indices, literal F1..F6 and lowercase channel, no spaces/newline
synthesis.frozen_input_serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, exactly one terminal LF; schema/content frozen in Mission 64 before evaluation
synthesis.randomness: No RNG; public deterministic counter construction. Modulo bias is not claimed absent; no distributional sampling claim.

research_question: Compare selection policies under fixed nominal slot scores, eligibility and a last-non-idle switching cost; independently verify the finite-model optimum.
scope: Synthetic supplied-input selection only; no calibrated astronomical utility or physical scheduling qualification.

source_references.author: Dimitri P. Bertsekas
source_references.role: Method background only; model and experimental choices are project definitions.
source_references.title: MIT 6.231 Dynamic Programming and Stochastic Control, Fall 2015 lecture slides

splits.access_rule: Candidate evaluation-reserved outputs remain unopened until candidate source/config, independent reference and thresholds are frozen. Log accesses. Public inputs are not a blind holdout.
splits.failure_rule: Retain failures; any repair produces new source/results, and repeated evaluation is labelled exposed regression evidence. No rerolls, denominator changes or post-hoc thresholds.
